_readme: National entrance exams added by hand (dates from news/official-portal reports on 'checked'; confirm on the exam body's site). dates = dated deadlines (hidden once past). expected = text for exams whose 2027 dates are not announced yet. Edit and re-run build-live-registry.js --cache.

exams.name: JEE Main 2027 (Session 1)
exams.about: National entrance test for B.Tech, B.E. and B.Arch admissions to NITs, IIITs and other institutes. The Session 1 notification was released on 24 Oct 2026.

dates.label: Session 1 registration closes
dates.note: Dates as reported after the notification. Confirm on the NTA notice.

exams.name: AILET 2027
exams.about: NLU Delhi's own entrance test for the 5-year BA LLB (Hons) and the one-year LLM.

dates.label: Registration closes
dates.note: An extension was announced last year, but do not count on one.

exams.name: UCEED 2027
exams.about: IIT Bombay's Undergraduate Common Entrance Exam for Design, for B.Des seats at IITs and partner institutes.

dates.label: Registration with late fee closes
dates.note: The regular deadline was 31 Oct 2026. One report says it was extended to 5 Nov.

exams.name: CEED 2027
exams.about: IIT Bombay's Common Entrance Examination for Design, for M.Des and design doctoral programmes.

dates.label: Registration with late fee closes
dates.note: The regular last date was reported as 5 Nov 2026.

exams.name: NID DAT 2027
exams.about: National Institute of Design's Design Aptitude Test for B.Des and M.Des admissions.

exams.name: SNAP 2026
exams.about: Symbiosis National Aptitude Test for MBA admission to Symbiosis institutes.

exams.name: XAT 2027
exams.about: XLRI's Xavier Aptitude Test, accepted by XLRI and many other management schools.

dates.label: Registration closes
dates.note: Some sites mention a possible extension.

exams.name: NEET UG 2027
exams.about: The national entrance test for undergraduate medical and dental courses. The 2027 dates are not announced yet.

exams.name: CUET UG 2027
exams.about: The common entrance test for undergraduate admission to central and many other universities. The 2027 dates are not announced yet.

exams.name: BITSAT 2027
exams.about: BITS Pilani's online admission test for its Pilani, Goa and Hyderabad campuses.
facts: Registration expected to open in Dec 2026

exams.name: NATA 2027
exams.about: The National Aptitude Test in Architecture for B.Arch admissions. The 2027 dates are not announced yet.

exams.name: NMIMS NPAT 2027
exams.about: NMIMS's own entrance test for undergraduate programmes. The 2027 dates are not confirmed.

exams.name: Symbiosis SET 2027
exams.about: The Symbiosis Entrance Test for undergraduate programmes at Symbiosis institutes. The 2027 dates are not announced yet.
